Holtz-Eakin: 50bps Hike Would Send ‘Important Message’
videos.description: American Action Forum President Douglas Holtz-Eakin says a half-point Federal Reserve rate hike would send an important message that policymakers are serious about returning inflation to target. The former Congressional Budget Office director says, however, tariffs and market volatility could ultimately lead the Fed to opt for a quarter-point move instead. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
videos.description: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year. Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, FIT Associate Professor Shawn Grain Carter, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, and Exemplary Luxury Group President and CCO Darcy Penick share their thoughts. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
